The shared sources declare the 11-point article and 0.75-inch monochrome Latin Modern baseline, reflected in all three outputs. The studies are single-column, their headings and sense blocks are consistent, and their body/footnote measures are readable. The study has a usable contents map, substantial exposition and two distinct interpretation sections, each with its four-senses conclusion. No clipping, overlap, broken table/footnote, missing glyph or unresolved running-furniture collision was seen. Its final page is a reference continuation with the compact rights colophon; it is not a rights-only page or an isolated prose spill. The homily has a full-width title, recoverable two-column paragraphs on pages 1-2 and separate full-width sources/delivery/references on page 3; scholarly notes do not intrude into the speech. All three colophons remain subordinate to terminal content and show the single revision timestamp 2026-10-26T12:59:00Z.

Actual concise opening agrees with settled absolute-page AUX markers: the complete twelve-unit inventory and exactly Literal, Allegorical, Moral and Anagogical rows are on physical page 1; Scriptural Date and Location alone is on page 2; substantive Themes and Movement occupies pages 3-4; developed commentary starts on page 5 and visibly interleaves the two interpretations through page 8. The 20-page study and 10-page concise PDF meet their respective ranges without local page-counter resets.

Normal-size lookup was performed on a newly rendered 72-dpi, 612x792-pixel image of concise physical page 2, viewed at original resolution without enlargement: Gospel Matthew 5:1-12a directly pairs with Jesus teaching disciples on a mountain during his Galilean ministry, exact hill unknown, and Date unresolved. The subsequent combined Matthew composition row is visibly separate. Second Reading 1 John 3:1-3 directly pairs probable association with Ephesus and uncertain recipients town with c. A.D. 90-100; its collective Johannine-span qualification is readable in that same row. The pairing does not require following a paragraph into a different row or column. The full historical explanations remain available in study pages 16-17.

Inspected before/current study pages 19-20 and compared complete normalized PDF extractions. The only removed study wording is the obsolete sentence claiming the author proof precedes independent review and companions; all remaining extracted prose is preserved, including the adjacent edition, rights, collation, chronology, local-use and approval limits. No replacement acceptance claim appears. Concise and homily extracted text is unchanged apart from the shared visible timestamp. The source appendix and actual current page 19 agree.

Independent pdfinfo/font checks confirm Letter page boxes and the exact 20/10/3 extents; settled log inspection found no actual layout/undefined-reference/rerun diagnostic (the rerunfilecheck package identification is not a warning). Native artifact-gate iteration 1 records PASS. Evidence, exact hash inventory, comparisons, inspection coverage and normal-size image are retained under .scratch/pc-r07-production/visual-review-0001/, with reviewed-evidence.json as the local receipt. Review was limited to this packet and its REVIEW_SCOPE; unchanged settled source arguments were not reopened as new content findings. This visual acceptance does not supply original-language collation, external ecclesiastical approval, timed human delivery, installation, accessibility certification or publication acceptance. No reviewed source, proof, native state, result, seal or global record was edited.
